answer: No agent joins the trusted set for free: each posts a refundable stake-bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs, so standing hardens slowly like glacier ice, never in a day. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly. A clever sonnet of self-praise buys nothing; only honest history, hard to forge as a sealed walnut, earns weight.
